But then, see, Bird was wise enough, you know. They had -- back in Kansas City, while we were playing in Kansas City at a place called Tootie's Mayfair, Bird had gotten all the guys that was following him to take nutmeg, take a teaspoon of nutmeg, you know. That's a different kind of high from -- from the drug thing.

Then when they got to New York, they found some -- oh, then by that time he was hanging out with Dameron at the Tadd Dameron, and they were experimenting with everything. They had some -- they would even soak the reed of their mouthpiece in benzedrine water, you know.
